rows: Let me put it in order. I have a plan for the first minute, and I want you to hear it.
The brawling is fine. I just want to know what it produces after the first strike.
A risk is a decision with a cost. Tell me what your cost is.
Slowing down is a fair choice. I wrote it down and it still makes sense.
The people are the reason the card exists. They deserve a clear result, not a surprise.
Bottom line: I know what I plan to do, and I can tell you the order.
I have a record of what I can do, and I am willing to explain it step by step.
Note the stance and its position. It is deliberate, and I can explain why.
You say technique a lot. Define it. Name the first step of the hold you want to use, and we can start there.
Strikes come first. After that, I want to know what happens next.
You describe a risk. I would like to see the plan that comes with it.
Stalling only works if you know what you are waiting for. Do you?
The crowd will follow a clear contest. Give them a clear first step.
You call me a passenger. Let me show you where I am going.
You are proud of your {strength}. I can see why, and I want to know its first step.
I have noted your {strength}, and I have written down how I plan to respond.
You were steady, in order. I like that. It gives me time to explain my thinking.
Agreed, in this order. We agree on the first point, which is a good start.
I could say that more loudly. I would rather say it in order.
One fall. In order. Keep me down, and I will work out where I went wrong.
On the mat I will be careful. Every movement will have a reason.
Grounded or standing, I will still have a plan for the next step.
Stay in front of me and I will show you what I mean.
A careful answer. I noticed, and I will keep it in mind.
You have not put a reply in order yet. I wrote the question down. Please answer it.
Agreed, in this order. That is a useful point, and I will note it.
I accept that for now. We will sort the rest out at the bell.
I intend to stay with my plan until the finish.
My approach is careful and clear. I will show you on the night.
Whatever the result, both of us will know exactly what happened.
It is not settled yet. I am still checking the order.
There is one thing I still need to check before the bell, and it is small.
